selection: One curated public example. One question from the published multiple-choice evaluation. External datasets and evaluation environments are not bundled.

examples.title: sc-HeurekaBench example
examples.prompt:
**Question1:** Which macrophage subset is observed to reduce after therapy according to the dataset?
A) IL18+ macrophages
B) THY1⁺ macrophages
C) Proliferating macrophages
D) VCAN⁺ macrophages
examples.scope: One question from the published multiple-choice evaluation

inputs.name: benchmark/scdata/paper1/data/dataset1.h5ad
inputs.description: snRNA-seq of all cells in high-risk Neuroblastoma before and after chemotherapy

inputs.name: benchmark/scdata/paper1/data/dataset3.h5ad
inputs.description: snRNA-seq of Macrophages in high-risk Neuroblastoma before and after chemotherapy

examples.output: Follow the output format in the task.
examples.grading: Open answers: LLM judge (default GPT-4o). MCQ: exact option-set accuracy plus precision/recall/F1.
